items.name: Rocket Hat
items.description: Ready for lift-off, one study session at a time.

items.name: Mint Rocket Hat
items.description: Mint paint, cream fins and a window for looking out.

items.name: Lilac Rocket Hat
items.description: Count down from ten, then start reading.

items.name: Comet Headband
items.description: A comet with a long tail, streaking past your ears.

items.name: Ice Comet Headband
items.description: Cold, bright and fast, for quick revision rounds.

items.name: Moon Crown
items.description: A crescent crown for the late-night study crowd.

items.name: UFO Hat
items.description: A friendly saucer that hovers over you while you focus.

items.name: Astronaut Helmet
items.description: A bubble visor, so you can see every page clearly.

items.name: Night Helmet
items.description: Dark shell, bright ideas, long library nights.

items.name: Comet Cheek Streak

items.name: Galaxy Sticker

items.description: Mint wool and a little ringed planet for company.

items.name: Lilac Planet Scarf
items.description: Soft lilac, and a planet that always comes along.

items.name: Moon Pendant

items.name: Mint Moon Pendant
items.description: A mint moon with a pink star beside it on the chain.

items.name: Astronaut Vest

items.description: The same mission patches, in fresh mint colours.

items.name: Jetpack
items.description: Two small flames for steady climbs up the revision list.

items.description: A small tin rocket to hold up while you count down.

items.name: Mint Toy Rocket
items.description: Mint paint and a rocket that never runs out of fuel.

items.description: Indigo paint and gold flames. Very serious about launch.

items.name: Moon Rock
items.description: A bit of moon to carry around. Heavier than it looks.

items.name: Mint Moon Rock
items.description: A mint-tinted moon rock, a lucky study stone.

items.name: Star Map

items.description: Space ice cream, reserved for finished chapters.

items.description: A violet lid, the same glitter, a bit more dramatic.

items.description: Two moons circle the buddy and never seem to tire.

items.description: A dome under a sky full of planets. For finishing the Space set.
